purpose: The capture half of a semantic profile for a DeepseekV4ForCausalLM checkpoint (DeepSeek-V4-Pro) served eager at TP8 on Hopper (sm_90, 8xH200) with DeepGEMM and FlashInfer on: every module the pinned vLLM builds for the checkpoint's config.json, what each one computes on the forward path, and the taps the committer attaches to -- each tap's capture-v2 identity (op, port, layer), the tensor's dtype and shape on one rank, where it is captured, the weights it reads and the Program that checks it, by status. The residual is mHC's four streams ([M, HC, H]) between layers, so every mHC call's four returns are taps; the compressors' state rows and the compressed cache rows they write are taps, because a later step's attention reads them. Checked against a meta-device build of the same config at TP8 (verity-vllm meta-inventory, ranks 0-7). route_site names the calls that decide a step's routes; the committer reads this map once no binder it names is capture work (route_source.unbuilt).

checkpoint.staged: vy-dsv4-fs:/workspace/fs/dsv4/b5968e9190ef611bbf34a7229255be88a0e937c1 (864.7 GB, every file's hash verified against the hub)

kernels.marlin: csrc/libtorch_stable/moe/marlin_moe_wna16 at the vLLM pin (moe_wna16_marlin_gemm, float4_e2m1f weights with e8m0 group-32 scales), built 8.0+PTX: on sm_90 the SASS is target.driver's JIT of its compute_80 PTX
kernels.flashinfer: 0.6.18 (fp8_blockscale_gemm_sm90: TRT-LLM's swapAB block-FP8 GEMM, the FP8 linears below 32 tokens)

inventory_runs.default: art:f3a53228045077f58b47d4417609529c9526e71f94e9427d5ad39c9c40f42bd7 (inv-tp8.json, ranks 0-7, the target profile: DeepGEMM on, e8m0 scales, FlashInfer present with nvcc on PATH; tests/check/fixtures/deepseek_v4). Produced by verity-vllm meta-inventory on a cloud-agent VM, not a research run: command.txt in the tree names the command, the venv and the stub driver. It replaces art:2e450ae48507dc3561421318c7fd995890d97a7435192b4d5fc6e1fe1ac5ab95, built without nvcc, where has_flashinfer() was False and every FP8 linear fell through to DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel

driver.why: the H200 pods' driver, on which GLM-5.3's H200 captures ran (r20261013-090127-6de9, r20261013-085842-2147, r20261012-220846-5d83). vLLM builds the Marlin MoE kernels 8.0+PTX, with no sm_90 SASS, so the driver JIT-compiles their compute_80 PTX. The JIT chooses no rounding: the PTX's floating-point instructions are mma.sync bf16 into f32, bf16x2 FMAs and bf16 casts with explicit rounding, and f32 adds with no f32 multiply to fuse into. It does choose the kernels' registers, which ops.cu reads to bound the blocks per SM, and so GRID and the fp32 fold order. The Marlin capture's gate holds the driver to this version, and its record names the sha256 of the JIT'd cubin and of each served kernel's SASS (tests/properties/dsv4_marlin_capture_gpu.py, phase jit); a serve on another driver needs its own capture

env_reasons.VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM: left at its default (1): the checkpoint's FP8 scales are ue8m0 (quantization_config.scale_fmt), and the FP8 linears' kernel is FlashInferFp8DeepGEMMDynamicBlockScaledKernel, whose fallback is DeepGEMM with e8m0 activation scales. VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0 makes that fallback unsupported and moves every FP8 linear to CUTLASS with f32 scales, a different function; the mHC TF32 GEMM, the o-projection einsum and the indexer logits call DeepGEMM whatever the variable says
env_reasons.VLLM_BLOCKSCALE_FP8_GEMM_FLASHINFER: left at its default (1), with FlashInfer present (vLLM's has_flashinfer: flashinfer-python 0.6.18 importable and nvcc on PATH, the pods' CUDA toolkit; or flashinfer-cubin): FlashInferFp8DeepGEMMDynamicBlockScaledKernel, the first of _POSSIBLE_FP8_BLOCK_KERNELS[CUDA], is supported on sm_90 and implements every FP8 linear here (bf16 in and out, e4m3 weights, N % 64 and K % 128). With 0, or a serve without nvcc and cubins, every FP8 linear is DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel at every token count: below 32 tokens a different function, which this map does not cover; the switches and the linears' kernel expectations fail such an engine
env_reasons.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT: not set: the Commit runs without it and replay uses the same batch layout
env_reasons.kv_cache_dtype: auto: DeepseekV4Attention rewrites it to fp8_ds_mla (_resolve_dsv4_kv_cache_dtype), the UE8M0 paged layout, 584 bytes per token (448 e4m3 NoPE + 64 bf16 RoPE + 8 scale bytes)
env_reasons.max_decode_batch: the serve's decode batch limit (max_num_seqs 16) until the TF32 mHC is pinned: a step of at most 16 tokens takes the fused FMA mHC kernel (route hc-fused); a larger one the TF32 path (hc-split), whose taps are committed-only
env_reasons.engine_args: vLLM's default Hopper kernels, chosen by the engine and held by the expectations: FlashInfer's swapAB GEMM below 32 tokens and DeepGEMM from 32 for the FP8 linears; DeepGEMM for the o-projection einsum, the TF32 mHC GEMM and the indexer logits; Marlin for the MXFP4 experts; FlashMLA for attention; the FP8 indexer cache. No MTP (speculative_config None: num_nextn_predict_layers 1 is not built), no expert parallelism (MegaMoE is sm_100 only)

selections.attention_backend: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention (_select_dsv4_attn_cls: FlashMLA on sm_90): decode tokens through flash_mla_with_kvcache over the SWA cache plus the compressed cache at the layer's indices; prefill tokens through flash_mla_sparse_fwd over gathered, dequantized rows, per chunk
selections.padded_heads: NHL = 16 query heads per rank, padded to NHP = 64 for FlashMLA; attn_sink has NHP entries
selections.fp8_linear_kernel: FlashInferFp8DeepGEMMDynamicBlockScaledKernel on every FP8 linear (kernels/linear/scaled_mm/flashinfer.py:149-330; wo_a's is built but its forward is the o-projection einsum). apply_block_scaled_mm passes the bf16 input to dynamic_flashinfer_deepgemm_blockscale_gemm, which branches on M, the linear's rows (the step's token count), with torch.cond (flashinfer.py:301-316): M < 32 FlashInfer's fp8_blockscale_gemm, its own 1x128 quantiser and TRT-LLM's swapAB GEMM (route fp8-swapab); M >= 32 per_token_group_quant_fp8 with ue8m0 scales, then DeepGEMM fp8_gemm_nt (route fp8-deepgemm). VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 would take the DeepGEMM branch at every M. The weights are processed once, by the DeepGEMM fallback (deepgemm_post_process_fp8_weight_block: the checkpoint's e8m0 scales upcast to f32, not requantised)
selections.o_projection: deep_gemm_fp8_o_proj: fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant (inverse RoPE on the last DR dims, 1x128 FP8 groups), DeepGEMM fp8_einsum('bhr,hdr->bhd', recipe (1, 128, 128) on sm_90) against wo_a's weight, then wo_b
selections.moe_backend: Mxfp4MoEMethod with Mxfp4MoeBackend.MARLIN (W4A16: float4_e2m1 weights, e8m0 group-32 scales, bf16 activations): fused_marlin_moe, two moe_wna16_marlin_gemm launches with use_fp32_reduce, then ops.moe_sum
selections.router: FusedTopKBiasRouter -> fused_topk_bias: sqrtsoftplus scores, top 6 of 384 with e_score_correction_bias for selection only, renormalised, x 2.5 (dsv4_topk); the first HASH layers route by tid2eid[input_ids] (topk_hash_softplus_sqrt)
selections.router_gemm: GateLinear: cuteDSL ll_bf16_gemm for M <= 16 (allow_ll_bf16_gemm), else torch.mm(x, W.T, out_dtype=float32)
selections.mhc: hc_mult 4, 20 Sinkhorn iterations. Layer 0's pre is mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang (DeepGEMM tf32_hc_prenorm_gemm at every token count); every later pre is fused with the previous post (mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang): FMA for M <= 16, DeepGEMM TF32 above. After the last layer, mhc_post_tilelang and hc_head_fused_kernel_tilelang, then model.norm
selections.compressors: every layer has one: compress_ratios[i] 4 (CSA, with an indexer) or 128 (HCA). The kv / score GEMM is torch.mm(out_dtype=float32) on fused_wkv_wgate's weight; save_partial_states keeps f32 state rows; at a ratio boundary compress_norm_rope_store_cutedsl (head 512) or _triton (the indexer's, head 128) writes one compressed cache row
selections.rotary: one DeepseekV4ScalingRotaryEmbedding (deepseek_yarn, compress_rope_theta 160000, factor 16, GPT-J interleaved, cos_sin_cache [1048576, 64] f32) shared by every layer, its compressor and its indexer
selections.indexer_cache: FP8: each compressed key 128 e4m3 bytes and one f32 ue8m0 scale, 132 bytes (use_fp4_kv false; the MXFP4 indexer cache is sm_10x only)
selections.embedding: VocabParallelEmbedding sharded (16160 rows per rank, use_fused_embedding): masked gather then all-reduce
selections.mtp: num_nextn_predict_layers 1 is not built: no speculative decoding in the serve command

routes.hc-fused: a step of at most 16 tokens (mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang: use_small_fma = num_tokens <= 16): each post-and-pre after layer 0's is mhc_fused_tilelang (the post, then the pre's GEMM and square sum by FMA in 4 K-splits at H = 7168; tile_n 2 below 8 tokens, else 3) and mhc_pre_big_fuse_with_norm_tilelang. Every decode step of the target's serve (decode batch <= 16)
routes.hc-split: a step of more than 16 tokens: mhc_post_tilelang, DeepGEMM tf32_hc_prenorm_gemm (TF32 tensor cores) and mhc_pre_big_fuse_with_norm_tilelang
routes.fp8-swapab: a step of fewer than 32 tokens (torch.cond(M < 32) in dynamic_flashinfer_deepgemm_blockscale_gemm): every FP8 linear is FlashInfer's fp8_blockscale_gemm, which quantises its bf16 input itself (scale_1x128_kernel) and runs TRT-LLM's swapAB GEMM. Every decode step of the target's serve (decode batch <= 16)
routes.fp8-deepgemm: a step of 32 tokens or more: every FP8 linear quantises its input with per_token_group_quant_fp8 (ue8m0 scales per 1x128) and runs DeepGEMM fp8_gemm_nt
routes.indexer-short: a step whose longest sequence has at most TOPK * CSA_R tokens (Indexer.forward: max_seq_len // compress_ratio <= topk_tokens; eager never captures): the indexer's compressor runs and _fill_short_context_topk_indices writes every compressed key; wq_b, the q quantisation and indexer_op do not run
routes.indexer-scored: a longer step: wq_b, fused_indexer_q_rope_quant, DeepGEMM's logits and the top-TOPK selection (SparseAttnIndexer)
routes.decode-tokens: the step has decode tokens (rows [0, MD), swa_metadata.num_decodes > 0): flash_mla_with_kvcache at the decode indices
routes.prefill-tokens: the step has prefill tokens (rows [MD, M)): flash_mla_sparse_fwd per prefill chunk over the gathered, dequantized cache rows

step_routes.prefill: prefill-tokens; hc-fused at M <= 16, else hc-split; fp8-swapab at M < 32, else fp8-deepgemm; indexer-short when the longest sequence has at most TOPK * CSA_R tokens, else indexer-scored
step_routes.decode: decode-tokens, hc-fused and fp8-swapab (decode batch <= 16); indexer-short or indexer-scored as for prefill
step_routes.mixed: decode-tokens and prefill-tokens, each on its own rows; one hc route and one fp8 route by the step's token count and one indexer route by its longest sequence
step_routes.recorded: per layer and step from route_site (acquire.sources.route_source): the attention rows at FlashMLA's _forward_decode and _forward_prefill calls, the hc route at each decoder layer's token count, the indexer route at each CSA indexer's return; a tap with a route is captured only on a step that takes it. The fp8 route names no tap: it picks the FP8 linears' Program by the step's token count

sites.detail: forward_mqa calls it when swa_metadata.num_decodes > 0, on rows [0, num_decode_tokens)
forward_mqa calls it when swa_metadata.num_prefills > 0, on rows [num_decode_tokens, M); a mixed step calls both
x is [M, H] on every layer, and both of the layer's mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang calls take the FMA path at use_small_fma = num_tokens <= 16 (kernels/mhc/tilelang.py:518) on the same M

returns (None, None, None) after its compressor and _fill_short_context_topk_indices when max_seq_len // compress_ratio <= topk_tokens, else the quantised query and weights for indexer_op; on CSA layers only, every one on the same indexer metadata

free_symbols.M: tokens this step on every rank (TP replicates the batch)
free_symbols.MS: rows sampled this step (logits_indices: one per running request)
free_symbols.MD: the step's decode tokens (swa_metadata.num_decode_tokens), rows [0, MD)
free_symbols.MP: the step's prefill tokens, rows [MD, M)
free_symbols.CTX: the indexer logits' key width: compressed keys of the prefill chunk, or of max_model_len on a decode step
free_symbols.NC4: compressed rows a CSA layer's compressor writes this step: tokens whose position + 1 is a multiple of CSA_R (row_counts)
free_symbols.NC128: compressed rows an HCA layer's compressor writes this step: tokens whose position + 1 is a multiple of HCA_R (row_counts)
free_symbols.NX: the HCA decode index width: cdiv(cdiv(max_model_len, HCA_R), 128) * 128 (c128a_max_compressed)

row_counts.note: a row count on a step is the number of its tokens whose position + 1 is a multiple of the count's ratio, over the positions the step commits under the positions tap: the compress kernels' mask recomputed from the step's own metadata, not the source's report of the rows it found.  A tap whose leading dimension is a row count that is 0 on a step writes no row there and the committer commits nothing under its name, so the identity check (route_source) and a reader of the commit (capture_map.bind_names) hold that name absent on the step and every other name present, and the step fails when the names the source found empty are not the same set.  Every layer of such a tap has the count's ratio in the config (layer_ratio, held by capture-map check) and on its compressor (held by the source when it attaches)

embedding-shard.note: one rank of VocabParallelEmbedding: the row table[tok - START] when the rank owns the token, else zeros (START = rank * VS)

all-gather.note: the logits all-gather: the concatenation of the 8 vocab shards (AllGather_v1 at WORLD 8 is a reference rearrangement, no gates)

token-select.note: greedy argmax over the gathered logits (temperature 0)

bf16-add.note: ATen add on bf16: bf16_rn(f32(a) + f32(b)) per element, NaN 0x7FC0 (MoERunner: shared_output + fused_output)

moe-sum.note: ops.moe_sum (moe_sum_vec_kernel): per element the f32 sum of the TOPK down rows from 0 in ascending k, rounded to bf16 (the rows already carry the router weights from the w2 launch)

copy-equality.note: a value no kernel computes, which the runtime only moves or takes from the step's schedule: checked by word equality against the taps it copies or the schedule (the prompt's ids, the previous step's sampled ids, each token's position), no Program

rmsnorm-cuda.note: model.norm: RMSNorm.forward_cuda without a residual (rms_norm). RMSNormFusedCuda_v1 models the width-8 kernel at the batch-invariant block size; the block size at H = 7168 without batch invariance must be pinned

fused-rmsnorm-triton.note: fused_q_kv_rmsnorm (vllm/models/common/ops/fused_qk_rmsnorm.py, _fused_q_kv_rmsnorm_kernel, grid (M, 2), BLOCK = next_power_of_2(max(QL, HD)) = 2048): program 0 the q_norm of qr, program 1 the kv_norm of kv, eps 1e-6; its reduction tree must be pinned against the Triton RMSNorm family at that block

cublas-bf16-gemm.note: cuBLAS bf16 F.linear with split-K off (lm_head.shard; the indexer's weights_proj): core's Gemm_v2{K, N, HopperBF16WgmmaDot16_v1} (Boolean Gemm_v3), as workstream A pins GLM-5.3's shapes (tests/properties/glm53_bf16_gemm_capture_gpu.py on cursor/glm53-committed-ops-8c79). DeepSeek-V4's shapes (K = 7168; N = 16160 and 64) need the same capture
cublas-bf16-gemm.when: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:16:8 and CUBLASLT_WORKSPACE_SIZE=1 before the first cuBLAS handle, allow_fp16/bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = (False, False) and preferred_blas_library('cublaslt') on every rank (vLLM's batch-invariant cuBLAS settings on cc 9.0 without its Triton overrides); not yet set by the served engine

cublas-f32-out.note: torch.mm(x, W.T, out_dtype=float32) on bf16 (the compressors' kv / score GEMMs, K = 7168, N = 4 * HD, 2 * HD or 4 * ID): cublas_bf16.GemmF32Out_v1{K, N, HopperBF16WgmmaDot16_v1} (Boolean _v2) on workstream A's branch, at GLM-5.3's shapes; these shapes need its capture too
cublas-f32-out.when: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:16:8 and CUBLASLT_WORKSPACE_SIZE=1 before the first cuBLAS handle, allow_fp16/bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = (False, False) and preferred_blas_library('cublaslt') on every rank (vLLM's batch-invariant cuBLAS settings on cc 9.0 without its Triton overrides); not yet set by the served engine

router-gemm.note: GateLinear bf16 x bf16 -> f32 (N = E = 384, K = H = 7168): M <= 16 the cuteDSL ll_bf16_gemm (ll_bf16.LlBf16DotprodGemm / LlBf16SplitKGemm on workstream A's branch; its dispatch and split at these statics must be captured), above that cublas-f32-out

tp-allreduce.note: the TP8 all-reduce on 8xH200 at WORLD 8 and N = H = 7168 (registry/tp_allreduce.py, #1945): the taps' all-reduces (embed, attn.wo_b, moe.out), which CudaCommunicator.all_reduce gives, at vLLM's defaults (the target's switches), FlashInfer's MNNVL all-reduce to 36 tokens (0.5 MiB / (7168 x 2 B); AllReduceMnnvl_v1) and torch's multimem_all_reduce_ past it to 64 MiB (AllReduceMultimem_v1, one f32 add tree per owner rank, GLM53_H200_TREE on all eight, IEEE adds), then NCCL; beside symmetric memory the custom all-reduce's cap is 256 KiB, inside FlashInfer's 0.5 MiB, so it takes none of them. Covered (tp_allreduce.covered('defaults', 7168, route, M), CAPTURED; run r20261013-115512-5ff3, the GO that also captured the 7168-wide all-reduces): FlashInfer 1-36 and multimem 37-2048 tokens. Boolean _v2 each. Port until a Build rule binds them. Every rank's partial is a tap, so the Program checks against the same root
tp-allreduce.when: vLLM's all-reduce defaults (target.switches) and calls of at most 2048 tokens: every decode step; a prefill step past 2048 tokens (the target leaves max_num_batched_tokens at vLLM's default) is not covered, nor is NCCL

fp8-block-linear-flashinfer.note: FlashInferFp8DeepGEMMDynamicBlockScaledKernel's M < 32 branch: FlashInfer fp8_blockscale_gemm quantises the bf16 input itself (scale_1x128_kernel: f32 scales per 1x128, not ue8m0; neither its words nor its scales leave the op) and runs TRT-LLM's swapAB GEMM against the checkpoint's e4m3 weight and its e8m0 128x128 block scales upcast to f32: per output the wgmma e4m3 k32 chain of each 128-wide K block, promoted into an f32 accumulator with the product of the two scales, rounded to bf16. FlashInferFp8Linear_v1{K, N} (FlashInferFp8Quant1x128_v1{K}, then fp8.ScaledMmFp8BlockCoordinate_v1 per output word). Row SHARED-DG
fp8-block-linear-flashinfer.when: route fp8-swapab: M < 32, every decode step of the serve and a prefill step of fewer than 32 tokens

fp8-block-linear-deepgemm.note: FlashInferFp8DeepGEMMDynamicBlockScaledKernel's M >= 32 branch: per_token_group_quant_fp8 of the input with ue8m0 (power-of-two) scales per 1x128 (Fp8GroupQuantUe8m0_v1{K, 128}), then DeepGEMM sm90 fp8_gemm_nt against the same weight and scales, the same GEMM chain. DeepGemmFp8Linear_v1{K, N}. Row SHARED-DG
fp8-block-linear-deepgemm.when: route fp8-deepgemm: M >= 32, a prefill or mixed step of 32 tokens or more

fp8-einsum-deepgemm.note: DeepGEMM fp8_einsum('bhr,hdr->bhd', recipe (1, 128, 128)) on one token: per o-group g, z[g] = the block-FP8 product of o_fp8[g] (scales o_scale[g], fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant's) and wo_a's weight rows of group g (e4m3, its e8m0 128x128 block scales upcast to f32 and reshaped to [OGL, OL / 128, HPG * HD / 128] at load, deepgemm_post_process_fp8_weight_block(is_bmm=True)), bf16 out. ScaledMmFp8BlockGrouped_v1{H, K, N, G} at H = OGL, K = HPG * HD, N = OL, G = 128. Row SHARED-DG

flashmla-sparse-decode.note: FlashMLA flash_mla_with_kvcache, sm90 sparse FP8 decode (is_fp8_kvcache, head_dim_v 512; registry/flashmla.py, #1955): per decode token FlashMlaDecode_v1{NH 16, SPLITS, NW, DN 448, DR 64, QT 64, BN 64, HopperBF16WgmmaDot16, 512^-0.5}, each row's validity and its row dequantized from the 584-byte fp8_ds_mla layout (FlashMlaRowValid_v1, FlashMlaKvRow_v1) over the SWA rows at swa_indices (swa_lens of them) then the compressed rows at the layer's extra indices (extra_topk_length), then per head the online softmax at softmax_scale = HD^-0.5 in 64-row blocks at the planner's splits (FlashMlaDecodeHead_v1: FlashMlaSplit_v1, and FlashMlaCombine_v1 over a token cut into several), the head's attn_sink in the denominator; NHP heads written, NHL kept. The H200's GO: run r20261013-115825-52cf (tests/properties/dsv4_flashmla_capture_gpu.py, the decode cases swa, c4, c128, lone, batch and edge). Boolean _v2. Port until a Build rule binds it

flashmla-sparse-prefill.note: FlashMLA flash_mla_sparse_fwd per prefill chunk (registry/flashmla_prefill.py, #1955): FlashMlaPrefill_v1{NH 16, NP, D 512, BN 64, HopperBF16WgmmaDot16, 512^-0.5} per token over the bf16 workspace dequantize_and_gather_k_cache writes (the CuTe gather, FlashMlaGatherRow_v1{DN 448, DR 64, QT 64}: the E4M3 byte times its group's scale s << 7), at the workspace indices and lengths combine_topk_swa_indices writes (registry/dsv4_indices.py, #1968: Dsv4CombineTopkSwa_v1{TOPK, RATIO, WINDOW 128, WIDTH}), with attn_sink. The H200's GO: run r20261013-115825-52cf (tests/properties/dsv4_flashmla_capture_gpu.py, the prefill cases), and for the indices run r20261013-205633-5489 (tests/properties/dsv4_indices_capture_gpu.py). Boolean _v2 each. Port until a Build rule binds it

mhc-post-pre-fma.note: mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang at M <= 16 (registry/mhc.py, #1961): per token MhcFusedPostPre_v1{HC 4, H 7168, NS 4, TH 256, TN 64, REPEAT 20, EPS 1e-6, HC_EPS 1e-6}, mhc_fused_tilelang per split of H (MhcFusedSplit_v1: the post, new residual[s] = post_mix[s] * x + sum_t comb_mix[t, s] * residual[t] in bf16 streams, and its share of the 24 mix logits against hc_fn and the square sum, by FMA) then mhc_pre_big_fuse_with_norm_tilelang (MhcPreBigFuse_v1: the split sums, rsqrt RMS, scale and base, sigmoid pre / post mixes, 20 Sinkhorn iterations for comb_mix, the layer input as the pre-mix of the streams, then the attn_norm / ffn_norm RMSNorm). The H200's GO: run r20261013-205619-36e8 (tests/properties/dsv4_mhc_capture_gpu.py, the fused cases at 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 15 and 16 tokens). No Boolean version (boolean_mhc: over circuit-check's partition budget); its pieces have one (MhcFusedSplit_v2, MhcPreBigFuse_v2). Port until a Build rule binds it

mhc-tf32.note: the TF32 pre (registry/mhc.py, #1961): DeepGEMM tf32_hc_prenorm_gemm (HopperTf32WgmmaDot8_v1 steps, split-K over compute_num_split's splits: MhcPrenormTf32_v1) then mhc_pre_big_fuse(_broadcast)_with_norm_tilelang. Layer 0's mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang takes it at every token count (MhcPreBroadcast_v1, NS 28; its residual, the embedding copied without arithmetic to each of the HC streams, is MhcResidualBroadcast_v1{HC 4, H 7168}), so it checks one mHC pre on every decode step; every later post-and-pre past 16 tokens (route hc-split) is mhc_post_tilelang, the GEMM and the big fuse: MhcPostPreTf32_v1. The H200's GO: run r20261013-205619-36e8 (tests/properties/dsv4_mhc_capture_gpu.py: the broadcast at 1, 16, 64 and 65 tokens, the TF32 path at 17, 64, 65, 128 and 129; every residual_out copy in the broadcast cases). Boolean: MhcPreBroadcast_v2, MhcResidualBroadcast_v2 and MhcPostPreTf32_v2 (boolean_mhc: Calls of the pieces' Boolean versions MhcPrenormTf32_v2, MhcPreBigFuse(Broadcast)_v2 and MhcPost_v2; the copy is wiring only). capture_work.done: dsv4 attention source: acquire.sources.dsv4_attention_source binds every tap of the binder under the map's names: fused_q_kv_rmsnorm's returns, the insert's return and the SWA rows at the SWA slot mapping after it, the projections' kv_score and indexer_kv_score, at _sparse_indexer_and_attn's entry each compressor's state rows and the compressed and indexer cache rows its kernel wrote this step (state slot and compressed slot set, (position + 1) % ratio == 0) and the scored indexer's index_q and index_weights, after it topk_indices_buffer[:M, :TOPK] (flushed) and o_padded[:MD, :NHL] and [MD:, :NHL] split at flash_mla_with_kvcache's rows, that call's index arguments over its rows, fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant's returns and fp8_einsum's z; route_source holds them to the step's routes (BINDERS).
